hero.alt: Old Babylonian Queen of the Night relief showing a winged female figure with taloned feet, lions, and owls
hero.caption: The Old Babylonian Queen of the Night relief is frequently identified as Lilith online, but the British Museum does not identify the figure securely. The uncertainty is part of the evidence.

incantationBowl.alt: Late-antique Aramaic incantation bowl with circular inscription
incantationBowl.caption: Late-antique incantation bowls document protective household practice against Liliths and related beings.
